sections.heading: Dashboard Not Loading
sections.excerpt: Dashboard blank or not loading: possible causes include database connection issue, missing required data, or rendering error. Try refreshing the application, checking the database connection, and verifying that all required master data is set up.

sections.heading: GST Not Showing in Reports
sections.excerpt: GST data not appearing in reports: possible causes include transactions not yet posted, incorrect GST rate or type on invoices, HSN or SAC code missing, or GST return period not aligned with transaction period.

sections.heading: Purchase Bill or Invoice Fails
sections.excerpt: Purchase bill or sales invoice creation fails: possible causes include missing mandatory fields, invalid supplier or customer reference, incorrect item or rate data, GST validation errors, or financial period issues.

sections.heading: Screen Blank or Not Loading
sections.excerpt: Screen appears blank or does not load: possible causes include routing error, missing component, data loading failure, permissions issue, or session timeout. Try navigating to the screen again, refreshing the application, or checking the console for errors.

sections.heading: Export Not Working
sections.excerpt: Export fails to generate output: possible causes include no data available to export, selected format not supported, file write permission issue, or export process timeout. Verify data exists and try again with a different format.

sections.heading: Feedback Submit Failing
sections.excerpt: Feedback submission fails: possible causes include network connectivity issue, form validation error, or server-side processing failure. Verify all required fields are filled and try again.

knownGaps.description: Runtime manualIndex.js exposes 3 keys not registered in manualLoader MANUAL_SOURCES (daily-operations-detailed, month-end-closing-detailed, import-export-detailed) — orphaned index entries with no consumer
knownGaps.mitigation: Documented here for the KG-5 inventory; cleanup is a separate maintenance task

knownGaps.description: BRAIN-1 repository has no manuals/index.json — manuals are governed by KG-5 and the runtime manual index only
knownGaps.mitigation: KG-5 is the governing inventory; a BRAIN-1 repository entry can be added in a future phase

knownGaps.description: WG-1 helpRefs point only to the Complete User Operations Manual; other manuals are not linked from workflow nodes
knownGaps.mitigation: KG-5 manualToWorkflowStage references provide the cross-graph coverage

validationRules: Every manual sourcePath must resolve under docs/manuals/
Every featureRef must resolve to an FF-1 feature node id
Every workflowStageRef must resolve to a WG-1 node id
Every screenRef must resolve to an RG-1 screen path
Every reportRef must resolve to a BRAIN-1 reports index id
Every errorRef must resolve to a BRAIN-1 errors index id
No live business data may be embedded in the graph

risk.notes: Knowledge-only graph. Cross-reference drift is mitigated by the verifier; manual staleness is tracked per manual via the status field.

metadata.regenerationTrigger: When manuals change, when the manual section index changes, or when referenced graphs change

plannedFeatures: Per-section cross-references where feature mapping confidence increases
Manual staleness tracking against feature status matrix
futureExtensions.runtimeIntegrationPhase: None — descriptive graph; runtime wiring requires a separate approved phase
